properties.originalText:
DUE TO SUMMER SEASONAL OPERATIONS IN LGTS AND MAKEDONIA TMA
REGULATIONS REGARDING TRAINING FLIGHTS ARE ISSUED AS FLW:
1. TOUCH AND GO ARE NOT ALLOWED AT THESSALONIKI AIRPORT.
2. IFR LOW APPROACHES ON RWY IN USE MAY BE ALLOWED BY ATC.
3. ONLY ONE (1) IFR TRAINING FLIGHT AT A TIME, EXECUTING INSTRUMENT 
APPROACH PROCEDURES (STAR/IAP/SID) WITHIN TMA, MAY BE ALLOWED, 
PROVIDING THREE (3) HOURS PRIOR APPROVAL BY ATC AND NO IMPACT ON ATC 
CAPACITY.
4. NIGHT VFR OPERATIONS ARE NOT ALLOWED.
5. VFR OVERFLIGHTS MAY AFFECT THE LATERAL LIMITS OF MAKEDONIA TMA, 
ONLY WITH PRIOR NOTICE AND NOT MORE THAN TWO (2) FLIGHTS AT A TIME.
6. LOCAL CIRCUIT FLIGHTS AT AIRFIELDS ARE EXCLUDED FORM THE ABOVE 
RESTRICTIONS.
7. OPERATIONAL/MILITARY/STATE AIRCRAFT ARE EXCLUDED FROM THE ABOVE 
RESTRICTIONS.
